items.name: RedBot
items.title: RedBot — Find the Good Thing You Saved
items.description: Connect your own Xiaohongshu account and put a useful save to work.
items.bring: Your invitation and your own Xiaohongshu account, or selected saved text.
items.result: A bounded collection scan, selected source text, conditions to check and an editable project prompt.
items.example: Check this saved free-tool claim, then help me use its method in my project.

items.name: DayCup
items.description: Make a better starting cup with the beans and equipment you have.
items.bring: Your brewer, grinder, beans and a taste observation.
items.result: A starting recipe and a place to record what to change next.

items.name: CleanPause
items.description: Clean your keyboard without accidentally typing or clicking.
items.bring: A supported Mac; Windows is a separate test preview.
items.result: Paused input while you clean, with a visible way to return.

items.name: EarBrief
items.description: Listen to a report when you have no time to read it.
items.bring: Selected source text plus the account and key required by EarBrief.
items.result: An audio version you can listen to away from the screen.

items.name: Design Agent
items.title: Design Agent — Turn Visual References into Usable Interfaces
items.description: Make your page closer to the references you like.
items.bring: Your page, a visual reference and what feels wrong.
items.result: A focused design change, implemented and checked in your project.
items.example: Use $design-agent to make this page feel closer to this reference. Keep its content and main action.

items.name: Project Rebuild Advisor
items.title: Project Rebuild Advisor — Know Whether to Repair, Recover, or Start Over
items.description: Work out whether a tangled project needs a repair or a fresh start.
items.bring: The existing project and the problem that made you consider rebuilding.
items.result: A reasoned recommendation and a bounded next step.
items.example: Use $diagnose-project-rebuild to inspect this project before I decide whether to start over.

items.name: Project Lessons Log
items.title: Project Lessons Log — Reuse Lessons Without Carrying Old Decisions
items.description: Keep the lesson from a costly mistake for the next project.
items.bring: What happened, what changed, and evidence of the result.
items.result: A project incident record and possible reusable lessons, with limits.
items.example: Use $experience-pack to record this incident and what would prevent it happening again.

items.name: Iteration Cleanup & Handoff
items.title: Iteration Cleanup & Handoff — Preserve Decisions and Remove Dead Work
items.description: Finish a project milestone so someone can pick it up safely.
items.bring: The project, completed work and the current milestone.
items.result: A checked handoff, preserved decisions and an explicit cleanup proposal.
items.example: Use $iteration-close to close this milestone. Preserve unfinished work and show me any proposed deletions.

items.name: Product System Map
items.title: Product System Map — Connect User Journeys to What You Need to Build
items.description: See what a product needs to let a user finish their task.
items.bring: An idea or codebase and the journey you want to understand.
items.result: A map of user steps, required behavior and missing paths.
items.example: Use $map-product-system to map the first-time user journey in this project.

items.name: Playlist Builder
items.title: Playlist Builder — Get a Verified Playlist You Can Actually Import
items.description: Get a playlist for your mood that you can import and play.
items.bring: A mood, a few songs or a listening situation.
items.result: A curated playlist with a verified import link.
items.example: Use $mixtape to make a playlist for a quiet evening cooking. Give me an import link.

items.name: First-Time User Tester
items.title: First-Time User Tester — See Where Your Product Confuses New Users
items.description: Find where a new user gets confused in your product.
items.bring: A runnable product or screenshots and the task a new user should finish.
items.result: An evidence-based report with the most useful fixes and retests.
items.example: Use $product-experience-officer to try this app as a first-time user. Can you finish its first task without help?

items.name: Prompt Cleaner
items.title: Prompt Cleaner — Turn Dictated Notes into Reusable Prompts
items.description: Turn messy or dictated notes into a prompt you can reuse.
items.bring: Your rough notes, corrections and intended request.
items.result: A clear reusable prompt that keeps your meaning.
items.example: Use $prompt-distill to turn these dictated notes into a reusable prompt. Keep my corrections.

items.name: GitHub Skill Publisher
items.title: GitHub Skill Publisher — Publish Skills and Track Discovery
items.description: Make a finished skill easy for someone else to understand and install.
items.bring: An owned skill and its source repository.
items.result: Reviewed instructions, tested improvements and a verified public release when authorized.
items.example: Use $publish-skill-product to review and release this owned skill, with evidence that installation works.

items.name: AI Instruction Stress Test
items.title: AI Instruction Stress Test — Find Trigger and Behavior Failures Before Release
items.description: Find where AI instructions could fail before you rely on them.
items.bring: A skill or instruction file and the people or situations it serves.
items.result: Labeled scenario simulations and specific fixes; not a guarantee of live behavior.
items.example: Use $scenario-probe to test these instructions against a beginner, a missing file and an ambiguous request.

items.name: Decision Thinking Partner
items.title: Decision Thinking Partner — Clarify Ambiguous Choices Without Fake Certainty
items.description: Think through a difficult choice before committing to it.
items.bring: The decision, constraints and real alternatives.
items.result: Clearer tradeoffs and a recommendation only when the evidence supports one.
items.example: Use $thinking-partner to compare these two directions with my constraints.

items.name: TaskDock
items.title: TaskDock — Keep Agent Work Ready to Continue
items.description: Pick up a project in a new chat without explaining everything again.
items.bring: Your task folder and the current goal.
items.result: A portable project record with current progress and a clear next step.
items.example: Use $taskdock to make this task ready to continue in a new chat. Keep the existing repository where it is.

items.name: Stock Portfolio Brief
items.title: Stock Portfolio Brief — Decide What Changed and What to Do
items.description: Understand what changed in your stock holdings and what deserves attention.
items.bring: Your holdings and the questions you want checked.
items.result: A sourced portfolio brief with data gaps and possible actions; no trades.
items.example: Use $daily-brief to review my holdings and explain which new facts matter to the original investment thesis.

items.name: Podcast Video Maker
items.title: Podcast Video Maker — Turn Source Material into a Directed Conversation
items.description: Turn source material into a podcast conversation you can review and produce.
items.bring: Your source, intended listener, production format and budget.
items.result: A directed conversation and an authorized production workflow; paid generation is separate.
items.example: Use $podcast-revival to develop a podcast conversation from this source. Start with a script for review.

items.name: Task Execution Coordinator
items.title: Task Execution Coordinator — Turn Intent into Verified Outcomes
items.description: Get several existing task owners working toward the same concrete result.
items.bring: Your directive, existing owners and the source of truth.
items.result: Scoped assignments and verified outcomes without a second task queue.
items.example: Use $major-tom to coordinate this outcome with the existing owners. Preserve their current holds.

items.name: Work Memory
items.title: Work Memory — Recover Current Context and Learn from Outcomes
items.description: Find the latest project decision without rereading old chats.
items.bring: A project and the decision or context you need to recover.
items.result: Relevant sourced context, current status and visible knowledge gaps.
items.example: Use $work-memory to recover the latest decision about this project and show what may be out of date.
